name: cru_absorb2
desc: The small black cat has been almost completely absorbed into the crocodile's gooey paint chest: only the tip of its purple witch hat and the end of its tail stick out of the thick pink goo, with a cat-shaped bulge visible under the surface. The crocodile looks smug and satisfied. Keep the crocodile's muscular cross pose, toothy sneer and melted puddle base exactly the same.
